thread:
harper: heads-up: saw request-id vanish in the Java sampleapp during an auth-refresh retry. spans split and log correlation fails. anyone looked at Java parity for retry propagation? :thinking:

joel_sdk: which HTTP client? okhttp, httpclient, or our internal wrapper? and is it sync or async retry path?

harper: using Java 21 HttpClient + a CompletableFuture-based retry wrapper in the sampleapp auth filter. flow: incoming X-Request-ID present -> token expired -> refresh future completes -> we issue a new request via client.sendAsync -> downstream logs show no x-request-id.

marta_obs: quick guess: context propagation for MDC/otel isn't being attached to the async retry callback. CompletableFuture callbacks run on different threads and MDC doesn't flow by default.

ellen: yep. Java's MDC needs explicit wiring or use of executor that copies context. we added a small utility in internal-utils for wrapping Runnables to capture/restore MDC. did sampleapp use that?

harper: sampleapp used a plain executor. switching to ContextAwareExecutor restored request-id in retries locally. i'll open a PR for the sampleapp to use our context-aware executor in auth middleware.

joel_sdk: good. two additional catches we've seen: 1) redaction in the logging pipeline sometimes collapses header maps when Authorization is masked, accidentally dropping x-request-id keys; 2) log level noise: debug logs for token refresh were set to INFO in some templates, causing noisy traces and masking the real sequence.

marta_obs: about redaction: the pipeline's helper currently replaces headers with a single sanitized string if any sensitive header is matched. that's wrong for multi-key maps. we should change it to iterate keys and redact values only. i'll file a patch in observability infra.

harper: noted. i'll include a small test that asserts headers map preserved after redaction for non-sensitive keys. also adding an integration test that runs the auth refresh path and asserts the same X-Request-ID across initial request, retry request headers, logs, and span attributes.

ellen: SDK parity note: add a "Retry-aware propagation" section in devex-sdks with Java example using ContextAwareExecutor, Node axios interceptor, Python contextvars.copy_context(), and Go header-clone helper. many teams hit this when they roll their own retry logic.

joel_sdk: also change default log level for token-refresh internals to DEBUG in sampleapp templates so prod doesn't get noisy traces. add a short migration note in release notes.

deploy-bot: canary rollback executed for auth-refresh-java at 2026-03-25T08:41:00Z :warning:

marta_obs: action items: 1) harper opens sampleapp PR to switch executor + add tests, 2) obs infra PR to change redactor to per-key mask and add unit tests, 3) devex doc PR for SDK parity + recommended patterns, 4) template change to lower token-refresh loglevel to DEBUG.

harper: will open PRs shortly and paste links here. leaving a short staging workaround in runbook: `export JAVA_REQID_PROPAGATE=true` to enable ContextAwareExecutor until templates land. :memo:

joel_sdk: thanks — once PRs land ping #eng-runtime and #devex so we can fold into SDK templates and sampleapp quickstarts. :thumbsup:
